title: CopyLoop: Fast Looped Transformer Decoding via Context Copying and Shallow Screening
abstract: arXiv:2610.38822v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Looped Transformers increase computational capacity through the repeated application of shared blocks, but their recurrent depth makes conventional full-depth decoding expensive. While existing speculative pipelines accelerate generation by processing consecutive token positions at varying depths, they are typically limited by sequential decoding overheads. We introduce CopyLoop, a training-free decoding algorithm that combines low-cost context-copy proposals with shallow screening and continuous recurrent scheduling. Rather than step-by-step generation, CopyLoop proposes multi-token suffixes from repeated context. It then evaluates them early at a shallow recurrent depth to efficiently filter out incorrect branches, processing newer blocks concurrently while earlier blocks are still progressing toward full-depth verification. We evaluate CopyLoop across six model checkpoints from the Ouro, Raven, and Huginn families, covering code gen

translated_title: CopyLoop：通过上下文复制与浅层筛查实现快速的循环Transformer解码
translated_abstract: 循环Transformer通过重复应用共享模块来提升计算能力，但其循环深度使得传统的全深度解码成本高昂。现有的投机式流水线虽然通过在不同深度处理连续的token位置来加速生成，但通常受限于顺序解码的开销。我们提出CopyLoop，这是一种无需训练的解码算法，它将低成本的上下文复制提案与浅层筛查及连续循环调度相结合。CopyLoop不采用逐步生成的方式，而是从重复的上下文中提出多token后缀。随后，它在较浅的循环深度下对这些后缀进行早期评估，以高效过滤掉错误的分支，同时在前面的模块仍在向全深度验证推进的过程中，并发处理较新的模块。我们在来自Ouro、Raven和Huginn系列的六个模型检查点上评估了CopyLoop，涵盖代码生成（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: CopyLoop是一种无需训练的循环Transformer加速解码算法，它通过从上下文复制生成多token提案、在浅层循环深度下提前筛查错误分支，并采用连续循环调度并发推进全深度验证，从而显著提升解码速度。
en_tdlr: CopyLoop is a training-free decoding algorithm that accelerates looped Transformer inference by proposing multi-token suffixes through context copying, screening candidate branches early at shallow recurrent depth, and concurrently scheduling full-depth verification.
